The '''SS-54 assault ship''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] model developed by [[Botajef Shipyards/Legends|Botajef Shipyards]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Originally designed for [[Planetary Security Forces]], it was misclassified as a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]&mdash;earning the name '''SS-54 light freighter'''&mdash;due to a clerical error. Subsequently, many assault ships were sold without clearance from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] authorities.

==History==
The [[Halo/Legends|''Halo'']], a ship belonging to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] crew led by [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]],<ref name="BH">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref> was an SS-54.<ref name="CWEGS1-2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref>
